config.autoclutch.title: AutoClutch Config
config.autoclutch.enabled.description: Toggle the mod on/off. When disabled, clutching will not be automated.
config.autoclutch.group.timing.descripti: Configure when the clutch material is placed during a fall. Higher mean = earlier placement, higher variance = more variation in timing.
config.autoclutch.mean.description: Average distance in blocks above ground when clutch material is placed. Range: 1.5-4.0 blocks. Recommended: 2.5 blocks.
config.autoclutch.variance.description: How much the timing varies, in blocks (standard deviation). Higher = more human-like variation. Safe range: 0.5-2.0 blocks. Recommended: 1.2 blocks.
